sloka: वाताश्च परुषा वान्ति कम्पते च वसुन्धरा ।पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीरुहाः ।। ६.४१.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: vātāśca paruṣā vānti kampate ca vasundharā ।parvatāgrāṇi vepante patanti dharaṇīruhāḥ ।। 6.41.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The winds are blowing severely, the earth is quaking in, the mountain peaks are shaking, and the elephants bearing the earth (in the four corners) are falling."
